comment_text: Kinda a fumble on Zeno to think of the strat, not use it out of fear of getting a ban, and then proceeding to keep the strat a secret and not tell anyone until it gets used against him. If its so banworthy then why not tell the tournament staff about it so it gets banned beforehand?
As someone who doesn't follow the scene it's clear the TOs are protecting MLC for poor sportsmanship.

Ban eido for spamming pauses until he fixes his internet. Also zeno makes a great a point about MC having no integrit. They dont care about protesting shit because they know it’s an exploit and they still play it out without delivering urn.

Zeno saying "Why didn't they talk to the TO's beforehand" sounds so terrible when you apply it to their own team. Zeno knew about this since the 24th and didn't bring it up either. Does that mean they were keeping it in the back pocket in case they needed it? Because that's what it looks like. They didn't bring it up to Deathy or Late Shift either. Saying 'Yea we knew about it also but MLC are larping with their reason' looks REAL bad when they didn't take any steps to try and get it squashed prior.

Also Eido said Floormen used a version of this strat on Monday in scrims. So were they testing it and Zeno wasn't telling us the whole story?

I don't buy MLC doing this to cheat a win. I do feel like someone should have talked to the TO's about this strat and showed what could actually happen and if the TO's didn't say it was banned, then do it live to put it on display. But all Zeno's words did was make me look at Floormen sideways.

And for the "You just want the money behind the veil of protesting." Why didn't they do it when they are either down 0-1? or were up 1-0 to lock the win in? On top of the fact if they wanted the money, they would have done it at the 12k tournament. Why leave risk to lose this tournament and open the strat before the tournament for like near 10x the cash?

It just doesn't make sense strategically to do it at 0-0 on a weekly tournament.
Bruh its a play test, why be mad that people take advantage of how the game works?
some people really have no pride in themselves lmfao such clown behavior ruining the image of themselves AND the entire deadlock nightshift

Literal closed beta with massive objective changes 2 days before the match is played and people are buttmad shit gets exploited. Ban it and move on, floorman are right to be mad but all the rest of us need to just enjoy the show. MLC acting like they did it so it gets patched is fake AF but who cares, it's not like Floormen didn't do the strat due to integrity, they just didn't think it would work / was worth it to do. It's 100% in the game, no bug being exploited, just mechanics pulled to the max.
Imagine someone forfeiting the game because enemy team played amazon delivery driver kelvin just sucking up boxes and owning, to me that's basically the same situation.
